Dream 2026-11-22 linked 5 vignettes from 3 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-27 · touches · "For many the generic editor is their first experience of srs." (The generic editor is many people's first experience of SRS, and muSrs must present a coherent view there: data first, tools after (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "the three column layout is not the right starting point" (Vignette 2026-10-30: I cannot understand these repos in srs-web; the three columns may be the wrong start)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "lets try the default to read view" (Vignette 2026-10-30: default to the Read view, as an experiment in reading by default)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "A repo should probably be able to specify a default way to be seen." (Vignette 2026-10-30: meaning must be available; a repository specifies how it is seen; packages define the editors and renderers)
- 2026-11-03 · touches · "If we have got a dedicated editor/lens for the current context, can we present it as a more obvious" (A dedicated lens should offer itself where its context is (2026-11-03))
